nodes.note: A walled road climbing nowhere, fifteen across and thirty-seven long, open to the sky. Four strongrooms open off it: a toll booth with a bell plate, a stair under an arrow slot, a dart gallery strung with a tripwire, and a strongbox under a loose roof. A lever beside each mouth makes the trap safe. The toll bar closes the north end.

stations.note: The plate in the mouth of the toll booth, the first strongroom on the east side at the foot of the pass. Stepping on it rings the warning bell.
The barrel at the back of the toll booth, behind the bell plate.
The plate on the landing at the top of the stair strongroom on the west side.
The arrow slot high in the back wall of the stair strongroom, over the landing.
The barrel on the stair landing, past the plate.
The lever on the road wall beside the stair strongroom's mouth, on the road side.
The tripwire string across the dart gallery, the narrow east strongroom, half-way along it.
The dart slot in the far end wall of the gallery, above the barrel.
The barrel at the far end of the dart gallery.
The lever on the road wall beside the gallery's mouth.
The trapped chest against the back wall of the strongbox room, the last strongroom on the west side.
The loose roof course over the cells in front of the strongbox.
The lever on the road wall beside the strongbox room's mouth.
The winch lever on the east side of the toll bar at the head of the pass.

nodes.intent: the road beyond the toll bar
nodes.note: The road running on north out of the gap, past the toll bar, open hillside either side.
